policies.eligibility: Full actual playable-class leaf family, excluding the current receiving hero class and neutral; no executable-subset filter.
policies.sampling: One independent uniform finite request per card, with replacement; freeze eligible class inventory at each root-body acceptance.
policies.combo: Execute printed native Combo effects; no real Hero Power activation, usage, mana payment or Inspire.
policies.neutral_placeholder: BE_720t12 preserved as full neutral evidence, not a playable class or executable effect.
policies.totem: Post-29.0 current basic Totems restore Wrath of Air and replace Strength. Use the shared ordinary and upgraded Hero Power family; this printed ordinary random summon still allows duplicate identities.
policies.historical_totem_power: K414 incorrectly treated the 20.0 change as current. The existing normal and upgraded powers already follow 29.0 and need no behavior change. Strength remains a reviewed standalone definition.
policies.calibration: Internal content policy, not CN live timing certification.

official_rules.fact: The Shaman Hero Power replaces Wrath of Air with Strength Totem.
29.0 restores Wrath of Air in place of Strength in the Shaman Hero Power pool; this supersedes 20.0 for the current fixed target.

policy_note: Current content declaration selects a distinct Combo behavior id; the previous Strength-based behavior id remains explicitly bound to the prior finite recipe. Old snapshots are not re-certified as current.
